name: @fluxfiles/editors-e2e
description: Live-browser Playwright tests for the TinyMCE / CKEditor 4 / Summernote plugins against the REAL editor libraries (vendored via npm). Verifies watermark handling: a burn-in (downloadable) image inserts, a preview-only (overlay watermark) image is refused.

scripts.setup: npm install --ignore-scripts && npx playwright install chromium
